reason: I already paid for salon software once and my girls never touched it, so it got cancelled. I count the drawer myself every night and the register works; I'm not paying ₹4,999 to learn the same lesson again.
objection: Half my ladies won't give their mobile number, and my staff won't take a selfie and type numbers for every walk-in when the parlour is busy. The whole thing depends on that, so it will sit unused like last time.
would_change_my_mind: No setup fee, and seeing it running in another small parlour like mine where the staff actually use it every day, with a way to bill a customer without taking her number.
